_comment: A two-argument `import()` of a bundled module is rewritten exactly like a one-argument one: the second argument is dropped and the specifier is redirected at the chunk that actually holds the target. The manual group merges the dynamic entry into `dyn.js`, so the call site collapses to the host chunk's namespace extraction and no `target.js` file is emitted. `target2.js` keeps a second entry in the group, so the group stays a shared host chunk.
